quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When a traffic signal turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up as fast as possible.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go through the intersection. But first, you must let pedestrians and other traffic finish crossing.

questions.question: What should you do to avoid losing grip on wet roads?
questions.explanation: Slow down on wet roads to prevent hydroplaning. Keep your tires in good condition. If you start to lose control, ease off the gas. Do not brake. Keep the car straight and let it slow down.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, continue through with care.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: The same as a yield sign.
The light is about to turn green.
The same as a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: When turning right, you must:

options.text: Yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
Watch for other cars turning right.
Yield to bicyclists between you and the road edge.

questions.explanation: When turning right, yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk. Watch for bicyclists between you and the road edge. Be alert to other cars turning right.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: In fog, rain, or snow, use:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, and snow. High beam light reflects back to you in these conditions, creating glare that makes it hard to see.

questions.question: You must tell the DMV about an address change within ____ days.
questions.explanation: You must update your address with the DMV within 60 days of moving.

questions.question: When is the road most slippery?

options.text: After it has rained for several hours.
After it has rained for one to two hours.

questions.explanation: Roads are slipperiest when rain first begins. Dirt and oil mix with water, creating a slick film on the road.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may go without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if two drivers arrive at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way. The other driver yields and may go when safe.

questions.question: You see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights behind you on a city street. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the right edge of the road and slow down.
Move to the right edge of the road and stop.
Stay in your lane, slow down, and let it pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right edge of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass. Move to the right edge of the road and stop until the emergency vehicle has passed. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then stop.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are harder to see at night than signs and other objects on the road.

questions.question: Another driver is trying to pass your car. What should you do?

options.text: Signal to the other driver when it is safe to pass.
Check for oncoming traffic and slow down to allow safe passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming traffic and slow down to allow safe passing.
questions.explanation: Stay to the right when another driver passes you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and slow down to make it easier for the other vehicle to move back into your lane.

questions.question: When should you leave more space than usual between your car and the car in front of you?
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an uphill slope. If the car ahead rolls backward when traffic starts moving, the extra space reduces the chance of a collision.

questions.question: What does a yellow left turn arrow mean?

options.text: Get ready to yield to oncoming traffic.
The protected left turn is ending.

questions.explanation: A yellow left arrow means the protected turn is ending and you must prepare to yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots?

options.text: Look in the inside rearview mirror.
Look in the outside rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: Mirrors cannot show your blind spots. You must turn and look over your shoulders to check them.

questions.question: What lane should you be in before turning left from a one-way street?

options.text: The lane nearest the left curb.
The lane nearest the center of the street.
The lane nearest the right curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane nearest the left curb.
questions.explanation: Always turn from the lane closest to the direction you are turning. For a left turn from a one-way street, use the lane nearest the left curb.

questions.question: When you turn onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you use?

options.text: The lane closest to the lane you came from.
The lane marked with an arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the lane you came from.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: When should you use your horn?

options.text: When you are driving through an intersection.
When you are passing a bicyclist.
When you see a child about to run into the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a child about to run into the street.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn others when they do not see you. For example, honk if a child runs into the street in front of you.

questions.question: Which of these must you obey first?
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions come before signs, signals, and road markings. Traffic officers, fire police, work zone flaggers, and school crossing guards all have this authority.

questions.question: What should you do if another driver is tailgating you?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is open.
If no right lane exists, slow down gradually when the road ahead is clear. This lets the tailgater pass you.

questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, move right if a lane is open. If not, slow down gradually once the road ahead is clear. This encourages them to pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. Orange-colored warning signs usually indicate construction areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming, so prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Slow down and use low beam headlights.
Slow down and use high beam headlights.
Turn your lights on and off to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and use low beam headlights. If fog is so thick you cannot see, pull off the road and wait for it to clear.
